div.style: color: rgb(23, 56, 93) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 后端解析、类型／归属／重复校验

span.p: 预览：有效、错误、文件内及库内重复
